differences: Rail and phone Library links navigate directly instead of offering media kinds. Tablet hides the contextual menu, preventing the agreed expansion.
Choosing a Library kind inside the navigation dialog does not close it.
suggestions: Use the existing native dialog as a focused Library chooser from compact navigation, with real filtered child links and native Escape/focus handling.
Close the chooser after a kind is selected; preserve inline desktop expansion.
reasoning: Independent architect review found an explicit user-contract violation. Native dialog reuse avoids a new overlay implementation and preserves keyboard access.
